title: Pricing
body: There are three plans. Starter is 49 dollars per seat per month, Growth is 89, and Enterprise is custom. Billing is monthly or annual, and annual saves fifteen percent.

title: Free trial
body: Every plan comes with a 14 day free trial. No card is needed to start, and you keep your data if you upgrade later.

title: Security and compliance
body: We are SOC 2 Type 2 certified and GDPR compliant. Data is encrypted in transit and at rest, and enterprise customers can request a signed data processing agreement.

title: Integrations
body: We connect to Salesforce, HubSpot, Slack and Zapier out of the box, and there is a REST API plus webhooks for anything else.

title: Support hours
body: Email support runs 24 hours a day on every plan. Growth adds live chat on weekdays, and Enterprise adds a one hour response guarantee.

title: Onboarding
body: Typical setup takes about two days. Enterprise customers get a dedicated onboarding engineer and a migration from your current tool at no extra cost.

title: Cancellation and refunds
body: You can cancel any time from the billing page. Annual plans are refunded pro rata within the first thirty days.

title: API rate limits
body: The API allows 100 requests per minute on Starter, 1000 on Growth, and custom limits on Enterprise. Bursts are smoothed rather than rejected.
